description: This file implements a ValidationService class responsible for executing data validation runs, managing validation reports, and interacting with a database and filesystem to store and retrieve validation artifacts. It contains key methods for running validations, storing, and retrieving reports, and performing various validation checks on data assets. The code also integrates an audit service for logging validation events.

classes.name: ValidationService
classes.description: Service class for executing data validation runs and managing validation reports, including interfacing with database storage, filesystem, and audit logging.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] execute_validation_run( self, data_asset_id: str, profile: str, actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )
methods.description: Performs a validation run for a specified data asset, generating a report, recording database entries, and auditing the event.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _execute_checks(self, data_asset_id: str, profile: str)
methods.description: Executes validation checks based on the provided profile and data asset; returns a list of check results.

methods.name: None _store_report(self, storage_ref: str, content: str)
methods.description: Stores the validation report JSON content to a file, ensuring directory existence.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_validation_report(self, validation_run_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a stored validation report and its details using the validation run ID.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_latest_validation_for_data_asset(self, data_asset_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches the most recent validation run data for a given data asset.
